ui_geomancyGameTip_guize.ch: 参照玲珑石盘周围所示的各元素方位，操作机关旋转，令所有元素在对应的方位上连成一线，即可复原成功 1.鼠标点击各环状区域可使其发生时针转动1格; 2.移动的同时，可能会照一定规则使其他圆环同时发生方向相同或相反的圆环移动1-2格。 3.中心汉字所示数字为剩余步数，请在限定的步数内完成风水盘的修复。
ui_geomancyGameTip_guize.en: To recover the compass, you may spin its parts to connect all elements into a line in the corresponding direction according to the diagram shown around the Exquisite Stone Plate 1. Click on each ring area to make it turn 1 tile clockwise; 2. While moving, other rings may move 1-2 tiles in the same or opposite direction at the same time according to certain rules. 3. Please recover the Feng Shui compass within the limited number of steps indicated at the center of it.

ui_geomancy_wanfashuoming.ch:
玩法说明：
<o>参照玲珑石盘周围所示的各元素方位，操作机关旋转，令所有元素在对应的方位上连成一线，即可复原成功</o>
1.鼠标点击各环状区域可使其发生时针转动1格;
2.移动的同时，可能会照一定规则使其他圆环同时发生方向相同或相反的圆环移动1-2格。
3.中心汉字所示数字为剩余步数，请按在限定的步数内调整机关的排布，使所有元素在对应的方位上连成一线，即可复原成功。
4.风水资质可以增加额外的可操作步数。
ui_geomancy_wanfashuoming.en:
Game Rules:
<o>To recover the compass, you may spin its parts to connect all elements into a line in the corresponding direction according to the diagram shown around the Exquisite Stone Plate.</o>
1. Click on each ring area to make it turn 1 tile clockwise;
2. While moving, other rings may also move 1-2 tiles in the same or opposite direction according to certain rules.
3. Please finish recovering elements in their directions within the limited number of steps indicated at the center of the compass.
4. Your Feng Shui stat will bring you bonus steps.

ui_gogEyeTipsConnect.ch:
<size=20>功能介绍：</size><size=2>

</size>1.昊天眼的神力可以令你在世界地图上视野范围更广
2.昊天眼有概率看破其他修仙者背包中尚不可见的物品
3.当在战斗中陷入危难之时，昊天眼可以发动天道庇佑救助玩家脱离战斗，但发动了神力之后昊天眼会进入破损状态（可以进行修复）
4.昊天眼神器在战斗中有概率识破妖兽的弱点，将弱点击破即可领悟妖兽的技能并为你所用

<size=20>使用说明
</size><size=2>

</size>1.战斗外按<r>F</r>键，可快速打开昊天眼神器界面
2.成功领悟技能后，可以在已领悟妖兽技能中点击按钮进行装配和切换
3.战斗中按<r>F</r>键，可以释放装配中的妖兽技能
4.领悟收集指定境界的5个更高境界的妖兽技能后，可点击突破按钮来提升已领悟技能的境界
5.当昊天眼发动天道庇佑损坏后，可以在神器页面中对其进行修复。需要花费一定灵石，且所需费用会随着境界和修复次数变化而提升
<r>（※在洪荒模式中，昊天眼无法修复※）</r>
6.当昊天眼处于破损状态时，无法再次发动天道庇佑；同时也无法使用已装配的妖兽技能，但仍可领悟新的妖兽技能
<r>（※在洪荒模式中，昊天眼无法修复※）</r>
ui_gogEyeTipsConnect.en:
<size=20>Functions:</size><size=2>

</size>1. The power of the Eye of Providence can give you a wider range of vision on the world map.
2.The Eye of Providence gives you a chance to see items that are not yet visible in the Inventories of other Cultivators.
3. When in danger in battle, the Eye of Providence can activate Heavenly Path Protection to help the player leave battle. However, after activating the power, the Eye of Providence will enter be broken (can be repaired).
4. The Eye of Providence gives you a chance to identify the weaknesses of Monsters in battle, and by attacking the weaknesses, you can gain Insight into the skills of the Monsters and use them for yourself.

<size=20>How to Use
</size><size=2>

</size>1. Press the <r>F</r> key outside of battle to quickly open the Eye of Providence Artifact interface.
2. After successfully gaining Insight into the skill, you can click the button to equip and switch among the comprehended Beast Skills.
3. Press the <r>F</r> key in battle to use the equipped Beast Skill.
4. After gaining Insight into the skills of 5 collected higher-Realm Monsters of the specified Realm, you can click the Breakthrough button to level up the Realm of the comprehended skills.
5. When the Eye of Providence activates Heavenly Path Protection and is damaged, you can repair it on the Artifact page. It costs a certain amount of Spirit Stones, and the cost increases with the Realm and the number of times it is repaired.
<r>(※The Eye of Providence cannot be repaired in Chaos mode※)</r>
6. When the Eye of Providence is broken, you cannot activate Heavenly Path Protection again. You also cannot use the equipped Beast Skills, but you can still gain Insight into new Beast Skills.
<r>(※The Eye of Providence cannot be repaired in Chaos mode※)</r>

ui_scribbles_wanfashuoming.ch:
玩法说明：
<o>参照笔迹图形的虚影部分，按住鼠标左键进行描绘，将虚影部分绘制完成，点击按钮提交完成画符</o>
1.画符共有3次机会，其中通过1次即可获得符箓产出；但3次均为通过画符将会失败，无法获得符箓产出
2.符箓绘制需要在限定时间内完成，光标外圈的金色圆环即为倒计时标记；超时将损失1次画符机会
3.提交绘制结果后，会将已绘制部分与虚影部分进行比对计算，虚影均被涂满且未涂出范围外方可判定通过
4.拖动鼠标绘制的过程可以中断，无需将将整个笔迹图形一笔画完
ui_scribbles_wanfashuoming.en:
Game Rules:
<o>Press and hold LMB to draw the talisman following the shade of indicated strokes. After finished the drawing, click Done to submit.</o>
1. You have 3 attempts to draw a talisman. If all attempts failed, you would not obtain a usable Charm.
2. You need to finish the drawing within a given time. The golden circle outside the cursor is the countdown timer, and you would lose 1 attempt once the talisman hasn't been finished after the time ran out.
3. Your drawing will undergo a check after finished. To pass the check, the drawing should cover all indicated shades and be without redundant strokes that are out of them.
4. It's OK to release LMB during drawing. The talisman can be finished with multiple strokes.

ui_shengjishuoming_des.ch:
升级说明:1.升级技能时会保留原有<r>词条</r>，并根据使用的升级道具品质，提供一定范围的词条进行选择添加
　　　　 2.若升级的<r>功法</r>新增了<r>功法词条</r>有可能会导致功法品质提升，若功法<r>没有更多的词条栏位</r>，则无法添加词条。
ui_shengjishuoming_des.en:
Upgrade Instruction: 1. The original <r>affixes</r> of the skill to be upgraded will remain unchanged, and the new affix could be selected from a certain scope decided by the rarity of the item used in the upgrade
　　　　 2. If the upgraded <r>Martial Art</r> is added a new <r>Martial Arts affix</r>, the rarity of the Martial Art may increase. New affixes cannot be added to a Martial Art when its <r>affix slots are full</r>.

ui_zmdbjfs_contentIntro.ch:
宗门积分赛为分别与其它宗门逐一对战的循环赛，胜利<#791515>积3分</color>，平局双方<#791515>各积1分</color>，失败<#791515>不积分</color>。
积分赛结束时，积分<#791515>前三名</color>可以获得擂台赛<#791515>出战资格</color>，最终角逐宗门大比的前三席位。
ui_zmdbjfs_contentIntro.en:
The Sect Points Race is a round robin competition against other Sects. Get <#791515>3 points</color> for victory. Both sides earn <#791515>1 point each</color> for a tie, and defeat means <#791515>no points</color>.
At the end of the Points Race, the <#791515>Top 3</color> in terms of points can obtain the <#791515>right to participate</color> in the Open Challenge Match, and eventually compete for the top 3 spots in the Sect Tournament.

ui_zmdbjfs_explain.ch:
宗门大比积分赛说明：
1.宗门大比积分赛采用五局三胜循环赛制，先获得三胜方获得本轮胜利。
2.上一局获胜方先选择出战弟子。对阵过程中允许使用道具栏上的道具和秘宝阁求取的秘宝。
ui_zmdbjfs_explain.en:
Sect Tournament Points Race Rules:
1. The Sect Tournament Points Race is a round-robin system where you have to win three out of five. The first to get three wins will win the round.
2. The winner of the previous round will select Disciples first. During the match, it is allowed to use the items in the item bar and treasures obtained from the Treasury.
